summary: CLAIM C-0004: Construction timeline and scale are broadly agreed (~2.3M blocks, avg 2.5t, ~146.6m tall, within ~20-27 years), but whether a single ramp could achieve the required pace is contested.
content: Scale figures (EV-0016, EV-0017) are broadly agreed: ~2.3 million blocks averaging ~2.5 tons, requiring ~1 block every 2-3 minutes to finish in Khufu's ~27-year reign. Whether any method could achieve this pace is debated: the 2026 IER model says a single ramp would need ~49.5 years (too slow) and only a multi-ramp strategy fits (EV-0018), a claim that is itself a model, not direct evidence.
